messages:
Leila (CSM): FYI — Kestrel Labs onboarding: embeddings pilot burned ~48k tokens/day yesterday after they ramped the sample set. QBR in 6 days — want a quick mitigation plan.
Sam (FinOps): thanks — pulling spend + forecast now. if current trend holds, projected monthly burn ~1.4M tokens, which exceeds their retainer. ping @Maria to gate onboarding throttles.
Maria (Onboarding): +1. can we enable prefix caching and reduce batch size? also want to pause synthetic load tests until we hit QBR.
Aj (Solutions): for embeddings, recommend quantized model q4_2 for batch jobs — ~2.4x cheaper. can we snapshot their model config? @Leila share model id.
Leila (CSM): model: kestrel-prod-v2. opened infra ticket #12345 to investigate node placement. customer feedback: they care about latency (<150ms) for search flows.
OpsBot: alert — account KESTREL reached 78% of monthly credits (threshold 75%).
Ravi (Success): noted. I'll schedule a 30m enablement to run through cache keys + usage patterns Tue 10am PT. adding playbook: https://redwood.internal/playbooks/onboarding-cost
Sam (FinOps): quick query run: ```SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM usage WHERE acct='kestrel' AND date >= now()-7d; -- result: 336000```
Maria (Onboarding): if we cap realtime inference to 75 RPS and route bulk embedding to batch nodes, should drop peak token rate by ~40%.
Aj (Solutions): also consider model routing: route 1) small-fast for search, 2) big-accurate for ranking. add auto-fallback policy to hosted-lite when dedicated capacity spikes.
Leila (CSM): OK action items: 1) Sam confirm forecast + flag billing; 2) Maria apply throttle + caching by EOD; 3) Aj propose model routing + quantization plan; 4) Ravi run enablement Tue. I'll update QBR deck with cost mitigation slide and customer feedback.
Ravi (Success): I'll capture the latency feedback and include in pre-QBR notes.
Leila (CSM): thanks team — tagging @finance-ops for visibility. :thumbsup: (reaction: :eyes:)
